candidates.sourceText:
Attack Actions have a maximum Range. A Combatants Range when using 
Attack Actions is determined by their equipped Weapons and Items. Only 
figures within Line of Sight of the target and within the Range listed on the 
equipped Item may be the target of an Attack.

candidates.sourceText:
To check whether a target is within Range of an Attack or a SPELL, the 
player counts the number of spaces from the figure that is performing the 
Action, to the space the target occupies. When determining if something 
is within Range they must also be within Line of Sight.

candidates.sourceText: This is both a type of Range and a type of Line of Sight. It is used by Spells and Spell-Like Abilities and represents the area in which a figure can exert their will. Every figure has an SOI. SOI has a base Range of 4 but this Range can be adjusted by Items and Abilities. When using SOI to determine Line of Sight, elevation, opponents, allies, and all Terrain other than Obstructing Terrain do not block or hinder Line of Sight in any way.
candidates.proposalText: A SOI é um tipo de Alcance e de Linha de Visão. Feitiços e Habilidades Semelhantes a Feitiço a usam para representar a área em que uma Miniatura pode exercer sua vontade. Cada Miniatura tem uma SOI. A SOI tem Alcance base 4, ajustável por Itens e Habilidades. Ao usar a SOI para determinar a Linha de Visão, Elevações, oponentes, aliados e todos os Terrenos exceto o Terreno Obstruído não bloqueiam nem dificultam a Linha de Visão.
